[size=4]INSTALL:[/size]

[size=4]1) Just unzip the file and place it in your 'Portraiture' mod folder. [/size]

[size=4]2) Then, rename the image to the name you gave your child (eg: If you named her 'Jessica', change the file name from 'GirlToddler.png' to 'Jessica.png')[/size]

[size=4]3) Once the game has loaded, use the default key 'P' when in dialogue with your child to select one of these images as their main image.[/size]
